title: Comprehensively investigating pharmacokinetics and metabolic fate of andrographolide in rats by liquid chromatography/mass spectrometry-based approach
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,11348-11360
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08654J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xuelin Sun, Yatong Zhang, Zhanpeng Shang, Lin Dou, Tianying Wang, Jiantao Qiu, Shuang Chen
In vivo disposition of Andrographolide was studied in rats. It showed high elimination and moderate bioavailability. 34/39 metabolites were sulfated, making sulfation its main pathway. A novel MS/MS workflow identified 4 sulfation sites.
